newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Companion Bld says in talks on investment.
newsitem.headline: Companion Bld says in talks on investment.

text.p: Companion Building Material Holdings Ltd said it is involved in negotiations with an independent third party which might lead to an investment by the third party in one of the company's subsidiaries.
But the company said in a notice published on Friday that no agreement had been signed and the investment might or might not materialise.

In a separate announcement, Companion Marble Holdings Ltd said the company was not engaged in any negotiations or agreements relating to intended acquisitions or realisations which were discloseable under the exchange's listing rules.
The notice said company chairman Leung Kwok Kui had exercised options to subscribe for five million shares at HK$0.89 per share.
It also said Shui and Leung Enterprises Ltd, a company in which Leung is a shareholder, sold 14.2 million shares in the company at a price of HK$1.80 to HK$1.87 per share.
Companion Marble was spun off by Companion Building and listed on the stock exchange in April 1996.
Companion Building was down HK$0.01 at HK$0.68 in early trade on Friday. Companion Marble was unchanged at HK$0.27.
